development.selection_policy: model choices and occupancy calibration use train/validation only

test.failure_policy: retain requested scene list; no aggregate ranking for incomplete runs

tracks.official_method: original representation, VLM and reconstruction protocol; report input and compute differences
tracks.shared_vlm: Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct NF4; matched input and query-budget comparisons require separately declared per-method recipes
tracks.reference_mesh: provided ABO geometry with recorded metric scale; separate from generated/reconstructed geometry

metrics.alde: macro natural-log error, lower is better
metrics.ape: macro fraction internally, percentage for display, lower is better
metrics.selection: report all four metrics; never replace aggregate results with a best object or best trial

statistics.resampling_unit: same scene IDs paired across methods
statistics.interval: 95% paired percentile bootstrap of per-scene errors and differences

ablation.binding_geometry: 2x2: original/local binding and convex/preserved closed geometry; density, thickness and core fractions fixed
ablation.full_pipeline: separate from fixed-parameter mechanism ablation; average every predeclared construction trial
ablation.budgets: report actual calls, input/output tokens, image pixels and inference time, including local audits and repairs
ablation.qem: matched achieved triangles; same conditional physical state; report mass, COM and inertia retention separately from absolute accuracy

publication.development_failure_diagnostics: retain locally; no manuscript failure-statistics figures requested
